targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', started_at) as Mese, COUNT(*) as "N. viaggi", ROUND(SUM(distance_km),0) as "Distanza (km)", ROUND(AVG(efficiency_kwh_100km),1) as "Efficienza media (kWh/100km)", ROUND(SUM(regen_kwh),1) as "Rigenerazione (kWh)" FROM trips WHERE strftime('%s', started_at)*1000 >= $__from AND strftime('%s', started_at)*1000 <= $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 24

targets.queryText: SELECT started_at as Inizio, ROUND(distance_km,1) as "Distanza (km)", ROUND(duration_min,0) as "Durata (min)", ROUND(efficiency_kwh_100km,1) as "Efficienza (kWh/100km)", ROUND(elevation_gain_m,0) as "Dislivello + (m)", ROUND(elevation_loss_m,0) as "Dislivello - (m)" FROM trips WHERE distance_km > 50 AND strftime('%s', started_at)*1000 >= $__from AND strftime('%s', started_at)*1000 <= $__to ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 30
